subject: SIG bulk submission: evidence delta packing & canonical prooflists
messages:
From: Emma Hart <compliance@greenwave-analytics.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Sep 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG bulk submission request — Greenwave

Hi Sean,

We're preparing a SIG submission for our procurement review cycle and want to do a bulk import of our required artifacts into a vendor portal (OneTrust or Whistic preferred). Attached is our SIG template with the questions we're asking (Greenwave_SIG_template.xlsx).

Primary asks:
- Can Redwood produce a canonical prooflist and a delta manifest (CSV) that maps your existing evidence to the SIG control IDs we sent?
- Can you package proofs for the delta items (PDFs/Screenshots) and provide an S3 staging path or directly upload to Whistic/OneTrust?
- Target window: we'd like the materials in the portal by 2025-09-23 for the audit team.

Please let me know if you need anything else up-front (contact for legal redlines, or an ACL for the S3 staging).

Thanks,
Emma Hart
Senior Procurement Analyst
Greenwave Analytics
From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Emma Hart <compliance@greenwave-analytics.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Sep 2025 10:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG bulk submission request — Greenwave

Hi Emma — thanks for the template and timeline.

We can do a two-phase approach that should meet your 9/23 target:
1) Produce a canonical prooflist that authors each SIG question to a single canonical evidence item where possible.
2) Create a delta manifest CSV that lists only items we need to package/upload (e.g., screenshots, export PDFs, SOC2 excerpts).

Irene and Ben are on copy — Irene will confirm mapping rules and whether we should canonicalize to the SOC 2 report or to live console screenshots. Ben will prepare the proof bundle and a short excerpt PDF for your review.

Action items for us:
- Sean: draft manifest and coordinate S3 staging ACLs (ETA 9/18)
- Ben: extract artifacts and create proof_excerpt.pdf (ETA 9/19)
- Irene: confirm mapping rules and any CAIQ equivalency requirements (ETA 9/17)

Can you confirm whether Whistic or OneTrust is the upload target? If you'd prefer portal upload, please share the portal invite link and desired access role.

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Senior Security Program Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Emma Hart <compliance@greenwave-analytics.com>
Date: Wed, 17 Sep 2025 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG bulk submission request — Greenwave

Emma / team — quick clarifications from mapping perspective:

- Preferred canonicalization: map to the SOC 2 report sections where a single report excerpt answers multiple SIG items (we'll link the page numbers). For anything where the SOC2 report is insufficient, we'll map to a console screenshot or policy PDF.
- CAIQ equivalency: we'll add a CAIQ column in the manifest so you can see equivalences.
- Sensitive artifacts: if any proofs contain customer transients, Ben and I will redact before upload and mark the manifest cell as "redacted" with a short reasoning field.

A couple of pragmatic rules we'll follow when building the manifest:
- If an answer is purely descriptive (policy text), point to the policy PDF with the section id.
- If the answer requires operational evidence (logs, config), provide a sanitized screenshot or export and a short step-by-step note in the manifest.

I'll start building the mapping spreadsheet and share a draft link by end of day 9/17.

Thanks,
Irene Choi
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Date: Fri, 19 Sep 2025 11:22:00 -0700

Team — attaching a small sample bundle and the first manifest draft (sig_delta_manifest_v1.csv). Items included:
- SOC2_Report_Excerpt.pdf (SOC2 section 3.2.1)
- proof_excerpt.pdf (screenshots of console showing retention setting)
- policy_backup_policy_v2.pdf (policy reference)

Staging plan: I'll upload the full bundle to s3://redwood-evidence/greenwave/2025-09/delta/ and send a pre-signed URL for the parts that can be shared externally. For redacted proofs I'll keep a redaction log in the manifest.

Attachments: sig_delta_manifest_v1.csv, proof_excerpt.pdf

Ben Carter
